description: Moves a file or folder in Google Drive into another folder. Takes the file ID and the destination folder ID. The item is added to the destination folder and removed from the folder or folders it was in, so it ends up in one place; its name, content and ID are unchanged. Returns the item's ID, name, the folder it is now in and its link. An item already in the destination folder is left where it is and reported as not moved.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

file_id.description: The Google Drive file or folder ID to move

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to move it into

name: gws-mcp__drive_move_file
